cases.question: ¿Cuántos periodos contables con estado abierto estuvieron vigentes en algún momento de marzo de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM accounting_period ap WHERE ap.status = 'OPEN' AND ap.start_date < DATE '2026-04-01' AND ap.end_date >= DATE '2026-03-01' LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS periodos_abiertos FROM public.accounting_period AS ap WHERE ap.status = 'OPEN' AND ap.start_date < CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) AND ap.end_date >= CAST('2026-03-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 50
